# The Wizard's Brush

> A local image and video studio with local inference and an opt-in Remote GPU lane.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/wizards-ecosystem/wizards-brush/blob/main/README.md)
- [API guide](https://github.com/wizards-ecosystem/wizards-brush/blob/main/docs/api.md)
- [Agents](https://github.com/wizards-ecosystem/wizards-brush/blob/main/docs/agents.md)
- [Working standards](https://github.com/wizards-ecosystem/wizards-brush/blob/main/AGENTS.md)

## Agents

Drive the same jobs through MCP at `/api/mcp`, or through the OpenAI image API
at `/api/openai/v1` (`GET /models`, `POST /images/generations`, `POST /images/edits`).
Model ids are friendly names such as `brush-fast` and `brush-quality`, and also
raw ids such as `local/klein` and `remote/quality`. `GET /models` lists the
friendly ids. Setup, the field mapping, and both error shapes are in
[docs/agents.md](https://github.com/wizards-ecosystem/wizards-brush/blob/main/docs/agents.md).
